messages:
Hannah: Morning drop  Waffles (duckling) discovered my desktop plant and has decided it's a private pond. photo: https://cdn.redwood.app/waffles/3512347890_waffles_pond.jpg
Ruth: omg the little ripples. does Waffles bring floaties?
Hannah: not yet. he brought a rogue paperclip and pronounced it a boat.
Diego: this feels like a conceptual art piece: "Office Freshwater Coexistence."
Amir: tiny quack, huge vibes. is he allowed supervised desk swims? :duck:
uploader-bot: Uploaded file "waffles_splash_loop.mp4"  https://cdn.redwood.app/waffles/3512347890_splash_loop.mp4
Ruth: watched it  0:02 when he flaps = immediate mood upgrade.
Diego: poll: formalize Waffles as our unofficial hydration officer? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Hannah: :thumbsup: yes, responsibilities include morale breaks and bread evaluation
Amir: :thumbsup:
Ruth: :thumbsup: yes and weekly duckling status updates
Diego: also accepting name suggestions for the plant-pond: "Deskford Pond", "The Plughole Marina", "Waffles' Wetland"
Hannah: saving this thread for the next all-hands intro slide. tiny mascot energy 497
